name: Give the release job no OIDC token
Give the release job no attestation store
Use the attestation action by its tag
Attest after the files are attached
old:
# Records that these exact files were built by this workflow from this
      # tag, so a download can be checked with `gh attestation verify`.
      - name: Attest build provenance of the release APK and bundle
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: |
            dist/LeanDoc-${{ steps.collect.outputs.version }}.apk
            dist/LeanDoc-${{ steps.collect.outputs.version }}.aab

      - name: Attach to the release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: gh release upload "${{ inputs.tag }}" dist/* --clobber
new:
- name: Attach to the release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: gh release upload "${{ inputs.tag }}" dist/* --clobber

      # Records that these exact files were built by this workflow from this
      # tag, so a download can be checked with `gh attestation verify`.
      - name: Attest build provenance of the release APK and bundle
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: |
            dist/LeanDoc-${{ steps.collect.outputs.version }}.apk
            dist/LeanDoc-${{ steps.collect.outputs.version }}.aab

name: Do not record the version for the attestation
